episodes.title: Undertaker
episodes.summary: Stellar Year 2148, Major Vladilena is forced to take the lead of District 86. Rumors says that whoever was its Head, they end up to resign or suicide. Vladilena does not believe it and wants to investigate.

episodes.title: Spearhead
episodes.summary: As Lena lives a life of safety and comfort inside the walls of her city, the 86ers fight a terrible battle against an unstoppable and inhuman enemy.

episodes.title: I Don`t Want to Die
episodes.summary: Lena finds herself growing closer to the Spearhead squadron, or so she thinks. But a deadly battle drastically changes her perspective.

episodes.title: Real Name
episodes.summary: After a brutal death, Lena comes to terms with her real status as an Alba, and what it means to force another to fight for your sake.

episodes.title: I'm with You
episodes.summary: Lena learns the truth about the upcoming end of the war, and how the Legion is a much more deadly threat than she thought.

episodes.title: Through to the End
episodes.summary: Spearhead enjoys a brief respite near the cherry blossoms outside the wall, but a deadly attack brings the dangers of war even closer to home.

episodes.title: Will You Remember Me?
episodes.summary: As the day of the festival arrives, Lena and Shin watch the fireworks and enjoy a brief respite from their battles.

episodes.title: Let`s Go
episodes.summary: Spearhead is given orders to undertake a pointless march into enemy territory, and not to stop until they're dead. Lena tries her best to stop this suicide mission from happening.

episodes.title: Goodbye
episodes.summary: Shin confronts his brother deep within Legion held territory. But even if he wins, there's no going back.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.summary: The crew of Spearhead has left on their final mission, never to return home. What awaits them outside the borders of their home?

episodes.title: Here We Go
episodes.summary: Spearhead Squadron comes to the end of their long road, and a new journey begins for Lena...

episodes.title: Welcome
episodes.summary: Spearhead awakens to find themselves in a strange new land, while Lena continues her battles as a Handler.

episodes.title: It's Too Late
episodes.summary: The members of Spearhead are given a brief respite from the war. But is it alright for them to enjoy themselves when so many have fallen?

episodes.title: Glad to Be Here
episodes.summary: The crew of Spearhead find themselves back on the battlefield, as the tide of the war turns against the Federacy.

episodes.title: Welcome Back
episodes.summary: The members of Spearhead are reunited as a massive Legion offensive looms. With the next deadly phase of the war almost here, how will they spend their remaining hours?

episodes.title: Even So
episodes.summary: The Legion's large-scale offensive begins, and the Spearhead crew are sent into the thick of the fighting. But even back at base, there's no safety to be found...

episodes.title: I Won't Forget
episodes.summary: As the war with the Legion rages on, the enemy makes a final march towards the Republic of San Magnolia. Lena waits to stop them, but...

episodes.title: The Truth Is
episodes.summary: The team prepares for a final suicide mission against "Morpho," a massive railgun Legion capable of single-handedly turning the tide of the battle.

episodes.title: Stay This Way Forever
episodes.summary: Nordlicht finds themselves up against a massive foe in the middle of enemy territory, with no hope of escape and no reinforcements coming to help.

episodes.title: Together Unto Death
episodes.summary: Deep in enemy territory, with supplies running low and damage piling up, Nordlicht makes a final desperate march towards Morpho.

episodes.title: All That's Left
episodes.summary: The members of Nordlicht drop out one by one in the face of the Legion's onslaught, and Shin is left to face the Morpho alone.
